questions.question: Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of telemarketing.
questions.solution_html:
• Advantages and disadvantages of telemarketing
  • Telemarketing is a direct marketing method where business use phone calls
  • video conferencing or the internet to connect with potential customers.
  • Advantages: Personalized interaction, cost effective and measurable.
  • Disadvantages: Regulatory risks, training costs and intrusiveness (often viewed
  • as a nuisance)

questions.question: Explain the role of content in social media marketing.
questions.solution_html:
• Social media marketing
  • A powerful form of digital advertising that utilizes various social media
  • applications to showcase products and services.eg. face book, twitter
  • Instagram. This type of advertising helps in increased brand exposure
  • facilitates targeted marketing, cost-effective, world-wide access, direct
  • interaction with audience which results in brand loyalty.
questions.final_answer: interaction with audience which results in brand loyalty

questions.question: Explain the importance of organizing.
questions.solution_html:
• Importance of organizing
  • Organizing is the process of dividing the total task and assigning duties to
  • proper or right persons.It facilitates specialization,avoids duplication,improves
  • efficiency,coordination,supports growth and achieve goals easily.
questions.final_answer: efficiency,coordination,supports growth and achieve goals easily
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Explain how automated customer support improves customer service efficiency
questions.solution_html:
• Automated customer support
  • A system that uses technology such as chatbots,AI and automated phone systems to handle
  • customer queries without direct human involvement.
  • Features include works 24/7, quick responses,reduces human staff and handle multiple
  • customers at a time.
  • It saves time and cost, improves customer satisfaction, fast problem solving and reduces
  • workload of employees, Improves efficiency and provides uniform and accurate information
  • every time and increases customer satisfaction
questions.final_answer: every time and increases customer satisfaction
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Give the definition and characteristics of management
questions.solution_html:
• Definition and characteristics of management
  • Management is the process of planning,organizing,directing and controlling the
  • resources of an organization to achieve its goals efficiently and effectively.
  •  Goal-oriented Intangible
  •  Universal process Both arts and science
  •  Multidisciplinary Human activity
  •  Continuous Social process
  •  Group activity System of authority
  •  Profession Creative function
  • (10x1 =10)
